entities.summary: Implement the `mlreport` CLI from `spec_v1.md` with `evaluate` and `compare` subcommands supporting all task types, Markdown/JSON reports, and compound regression comparison rules.

instruction_head:
Implement the ML evaluation report engine defined in `/app/docs/spec_v1.md`.

The spec defines a CLI tool called `mlreport` with two subcommands: `evaluate` (compute metrics from raw predictions and generate reports) and `compare` (compare two model evaluations and detect regressions). The tool must handle all three task types (binary classification, multiclass classification, regression), produce both Markdown and JSON reports, and enforce compound regression rules during comparison. existing v1 evaluate and compare functionality must continue to work
compound regression comparison rules must reference the renamed smape metric consistently
